data.description: 【澄闪 · 花房】开满温室花卉的罗德岛生态种植舱内，苏茜提着小喷壶弯下腰，温柔地给一盆盆盛开的金盏花浇水。几缕跳跃的微弱静电火花在她的指尖与花瓣间闪烁——「源石技艺带来的静电虽然偶尔会惹小麻烦……但用来刺激植物生长，花朵开得比平时更加鲜艳了呢。」
data.promptProse: Goldenglow bends over the greenhouse marigolds and directs water from a small can toward their soil, faint static jumping between fingers and petals. Cream-pink and mint tea dress, frills, ribbon bows and Mary Jane shoes retain her chosen outfit. The medium view follows flower rows beneath the greenhouse panes. Morning light filters through humid air and leaves onto the dress and water droplets, casting layered plant shadows across the growing beds.
data.title: 澄闪 · 花房
